hv_authorised_person.classification: separate synthetic appointment, not an O&M interview requirement
hv_authorised_person.scope: The AP posting separately requires HVAP, full OSSC, medical fitness, documented switching experience, an AP interview and site familiarisation.
hv_authorised_person.insurer_scope_ambiguity: The HVAP scheme note says insurer-mandated for the Carrowmore Array, while the mandatory insurer language is explicit in the separate AP posting. The exact boundary for individual O&M duties is not supplied; no AP requirement is imported wholesale into O&M triage.

safety_mapping.scope: OSSC-SS/FF/FA and WAHS-1 are record checks, not proof of an employer-accepted package. The posting does not specify whether WAHS-2 climbing, WAHS-4 rescue or another package is required.

employer_checks.classification: recommended verification, not an express O&M-posting requirement
employer_checks.scope: Permit, isolation and practical checks are proposed in proportion to duties. The O&M posting states assessed capability at offer but does not prescribe that exact suite.

scheme_periods.scope: Supplied renewal periods and prerequisites are preserved. Nominal dates are consistency checks requiring issuer verification where inconsistent; no GWO duration or external policy is imported as binding.

method.work_evidence: Every clean log entry for each profile is reviewed. An entry normally needs an explicit maintenance action plus an electrical or mechanical plant term; superficial numeric, measurement and equivalent permit/PTW/permit-bk workflow variants are collapsed only for diversity counting. The strongest examples and at least one exact cited record for every claimed category are shown, except named material records needed to explain a conflict. Counts, hours and repetition are not competence.
method.appraisals: Every appraisal carrying an exact current-cohort keeper_code is mechanically processed. A bounded manual review covered technical-topic candidates and named omissions used to refine the same-sentence selector; this is not a claim of complete semantic human review of all 305 rows. Name-only/null-key rows are not attached. Year-only records matching the scenario year are context-only; future years are excluded from testimony and conclusions.
method.decision_categories: supported_technical_interview; targeted_screening_first; insufficient_evidence; outside_current_redeployment_cohort. Every current profile is reviewed individually; no score, rank, numerical workflow threshold, adverse-appraisal window or keyword veto decides the category.
method.supported_technical_interview: Specific attributed evidence supports plausible hands-on mechanical or electrical maintenance. The reason explains the activity and transferable relevance; adverse, sparse or old evidence alone is not a veto.
method.targeted_screening_first: A named material unresolved attribution problem or contradiction concerning the core experience claim requires clarification before a technical interview.
method.insufficient_evidence: The bounded sources do not establish essential hands-on mechanical or electrical maintenance. Missing evidence is not a finding that the person lacks experience.
method.training: Dated LearnHub outcome and supplied expiry are evaluated at the explicit cutoff. Pass, Attended and Not achieved remain distinct. Year-only clean completions are reconciled to reliable detailed dates before derived module sequences are stated. Clean validity summaries and detailed module expiries remain separate source claims. Nominal fictional-scheme dates are consistency checks only; issuer verification is required where sources disagree.
method.height_mapping: OSSC-SS/FF/FA plus WAHS-1 is a provisional record mapping only. Employer/issuer acceptance and climbing/rescue scope are not supplied and must be confirmed.
method.identity: Raw keeper codes, payroll references and names are identified separately. Integer-like payroll values may be normalized across leading-zero, decimal and scientific notation only; absent or conflicting identifiers remain explicit and clean attribution is never rewritten.
method.action_dependencies: Issuer verification precedes spending decisions; working-condition willingness is confirmed before courses; medical clearance precedes OSSC; verified OSSC-SS precedes WAHS. The posting funds renewals but does not define renewal routes or promise first-time training funding. Proposed employer checks are labelled recommendations.
method.alternate_date_boundary: The supplied current/leaver roster is a snapshot, not a reconstructed historical workforce. The explicit scenario date filters work, appraisal and training evidence; it does not reconstruct prior employment status.

The posting says the employer funds renewals, but it does not define the route or promise first-time training funding. OSSC-FF: present and issuer-verify the current dated Pass (LH500817). Only if current required coverage remains unestablished should training and assessment be arranged if progression is approved (first-time funding is not promised).

candidates.name: Tomaltach Yarrowfell
candidates.recommendation_reason: CL009097 (2021-08-23) records "Rebuilt the clockwork drive, cleaned forty years of gum out of the train."; CL005994 (2012-02-13) records "Drive motor brushes and commutator dressed, rotation back to time.". This is specific, attributed evidence of hands-on electrical and mechanical maintenance with transferable relevance to the O&M posting's plant-maintenance work. However, material contradiction in AP003496: Attributed motor-brush, commutator and optic-mechanism records conflict with AP003496's direct statement that the manager had not observed the plant work suggested by the record and that two requests for assistance were avoided. Clarification is needed before a technical interview; neither source is silently preferred.

policy.supported_technical_interview: Specific attributed evidence supports plausible hands-on mechanical or electrical maintenance experience; adverse, sparse or old evidence is discussed but is not an automatic veto.
policy.targeted_screening_first: A named material attribution problem or contradiction concerning the core experience claim must be clarified before a technical interview.
policy.insufficient_evidence: The bounded sources do not establish essential hands-on mechanical or electrical maintenance; missing records are not proof that the person lacks experience.
policy.year_precision: A 2026 year-only appraisal is context only because its position relative to 2026-10-11 is unknown.

individual_policy_review.material_unresolved_issue: Attributed motor-brush, commutator and optic-mechanism records conflict with AP003496's direct statement that the manager had not observed the plant work suggested by the record and that two requests for assistance were avoided.
unresolved_questions: Before a technical interview, establish which work Tomaltach performed personally, whether the optic and clockwork activities meet the employer's plant-maintenance criterion, and why AP003496 differs from the logs and other manager testimony.
